card.name: The 'et' in 'et al.' citations
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'et' right after an author's surname inside a citation such as (Peterson et al., 2002). Also fires on a few other short abbreviation-like pieces such as 'th' in 106th Cong. and 'sq' in sq mi.
